title: Daily 5, Sat 28 Nov
sourceNote: Original questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 5 questions, 10 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Everyone gets the same five. The ranking is by marks, then by time.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, rupee sign or units.

questions.text: A sum doubles in 5 years at compound interest. At the same rate, in how many years will it become 8 times itself?
A and B together finish a job in 12 days, B and C in 15 days, and C and A in 20 days. How many days do A, B and C take working together?
The product of two consecutive positive even integers is 168. What is their sum?
An election has two candidates. The winner gets 58% of the valid votes and wins by 4,800 votes. How many valid votes were cast?
The average of 11 results is 60. The average of the first 6 is 58 and the average of the last 6 is 63. What is the 6th result?
